fusions.name: Cold-Water Ambush
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.6 times at maximum range. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Exhale
fusions.desc: Spouts a cone of sun-heated breath, dealing 26 damage to everything caught in it and leaving them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Basking Float
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunlit Stillness
fusions.desc: By day, your armour rises by 10%.
